note.question: What determines the value and potential drawbacks of tradability in LPs?
note.overview: Loyalty programs (LPs) are widely used to enhance customer retention and firm profitability. With technological advancements like blockchain, many brands are exploring tokenized LPs. Unlike traditional LPs, where rewards can only be redeemed for future purchases, tokenized LPs introduce tradability, allowing customers to trade their loyalty points with others or for cash.

Compared to the benchmark case where the ﬁrm oﬀers no loyalty program, a traditional loyalty program enables the ﬁrm to implement purchase-history-based price discrimination, where ﬁrst-period buyers receive a lower price in the second period than those who did not purchase before.
